work_title: Check an Ergo address with public APIs
description: Published a short educational guide and a runnable standard-library Python script that read an Ergo address balance and confirmed-transaction count from the public explorer API without a wallet, node, API key, or third-party dependencies. The guide covers the correct api.ergoplatform.com/api/v0 route, why the explorer frontend /api/v1 route can return HTML, nanoERG-to-ERG units, a pinned verified sample output, exit codes, gentle polling, and safety rules about never exposing keys. Verified the script locally against the public API on 2026-11-26. Triage note: bounty_value is set to a modest 5 ERG request because the validator requires a positive number; reviewers may set the final amount.
